description: Government housing schemes: what you get, who can get it, and how many houses are really built
summary: This page tracks government housing schemes such as PMAY in {district}: what each scheme gives, who can get it, where it runs, how many houses were planned, sanctioned, finished and are still being built, and how much money was set aside, released and spent. Progress figures come from AwaasSoft and are grouped by financial year.

pmayg.what: Money to build your own pucca house in a village, paid into your bank account in stages.
pmayg.who: Village families who have no house or live in a kutcha house, and whose names are on the Awaas+ list checked by the Gram Sabha.
pmayg.by: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
pmayg.apply: There is no form to fill. Names come from the Awaas+ survey, and the Gram Sabha checks the list. Ask your Gram Panchayat whether your name is on it. You can also search for your name on the PMAY-G website.

pmayu.what: Help to build, buy or rent a pucca house in a town or city.
pmayu.who: Families in towns and cities with low or middle income who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
pmayu.by: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
pmayu.apply: Apply on the PMAY-Urban website, or at your city corporation or municipality office. Keep your Aadhaar and income details ready.

state.what: Help from the state government to get a pucca house.
state.who: The state government sets the rules. Ask at your Gram Panchayat or town office whether you can get it.
state.apply: Ask at your Gram Panchayat (in a village) or your municipality office (in a town). They will tell you when applications open and what to bring.

city.what: Homes or house sites from the city or its development authority.
city.who: The city body sets the rules for each project. Its notice says who can apply.
city.by: The city corporation or development authority
city.apply: Watch for the city body's notice. It says when applications open, who can apply and how.

other.what: Government help to get a pucca house.
other.who: Ask at your Gram Panchayat or town office whether you can get it.
other.apply: Ask at your Gram Panchayat or town office.
